'''Andrew Marchand Screw You''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Andrew Marchand]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-229">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/229 Screw You], DeckTech (Andrew "Ozymandias" Marchand, 24 August 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/229/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/229/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018233002/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/229/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Screw You'''
* '''Author:''' Andrew "Ozymandias" Marchand
* '''Published:''' August 24, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Mains and Toys with Scanning Crews a plenty.

=== Strategy ===

Scan away nasty EPP's. Get your hit squads down (Vader/Tarkin, Fett/Dr. E, Igar/Tempest1) I love always thinking it is a nasty surprise. Control on steroids Start with Cantina then CR for TJabbas Palace
